newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL noon rubber down on ringgit, Italy sale reported.
newsitem.headline: KL noon rubber down on ringgit, Italy sale reported.

text.p: Malaysia's rubber market was quoted down at midday as a volalite ringgit kept players at the sidelines, traders said.
They said bids were also coming in at levels lower than those sought by sellers, forcing prices down.
"The movement of the ringgit is a little unpredictable again...buyers are waiting for a clearer trend," said a trader.
Government trade sources said they heard an 80-tonne consignment of SMR 5 was sold to Italy at 256 cents a kg for September shipment.
Traders disputed the price of the transaction, saying the trade value for the SMR 5 was only around 253-254 cents.
Traders said they also heard of light SMR20 sales being done, but added that no other details were available. "I think whatever's going is just hand-to-mouth covering."
At midday, the RSS1 for September buyer was officially quoted at 248 cents (95 U.S. cents) a kg, down a cent from Tuesday's close.
The SMR20 for September buyer was at 247.50, down half cent.
Dealers offered SMR CV at 292 cents, SMR L at 273, SMR 5 at 253, SMR 10 at 247, SMR 20 at 245 and drum latex at 189.
Malaysia-based shipping brokers quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $700 per 20-ft container, and $1,400 per 40-ft container.
